shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: One who eats without worshipping Waheguru,
The Sikh who pays visit to a prostitute,(38)

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ ਵੁਹ ਸਿਖ ਨਾ ਭਾਵੈ। (੩੯)
verses.translit_en: kahe gobi(n)dh si(n)gh vuh sikh naa bhaavai| (39)

en.bdb: Says Gobind Singh, such a Sikh is not regarded.(39)
One who is cunning and impostor for the Guru,
He should be considered severely punishable.(40)

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਛੋਡ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਉਂ ਮਾਂਗੇ
verses.translit_en: gur ko chhodd avar siau(n) maa(n)ge

en.bdb: Abandoning the Guru, one who goes to beg others,
And sleeps at night without anything on,(41)

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਗਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਰ ਭੋਗ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ
verses.translit_en: nagan hoi kar bhog jo kare

en.bdb: Unclothed one who revels in sex,
And all naked cleans his teeth,(42)

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਗਨ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਹਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਨਗਨ ਸੀਸ ਜੋ ਖਾਇ
verses.translit_en: nagan hoi baahar firai nagan sees jo khai

en.bdb: One who goes around naked or eats bare headed,

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਗਨ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜੋ ਬਾਂਟਈ ਤਨਖ਼ਾਹੀ ਬਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ। (੪੩)
verses.translit_en: nagan prasaadh jo baa(n)Tiee tanakhhaahee baddaa kahai| (43)

en.bdb: Or gives out sacred pudding in a naked state is judged as a big offender.(43)
